items.quote: Jehoiada brought out the king’s son and put the crown on him; he presented him with a copy of the covenant
items.contrast: Jehoiada as giver versus the king’s son as recipient.
items.reason: The alternative reverses the roles, but “he” continues to refer to Jehoiada, while “him” refers to the king’s son. The question clearly asks for the giver, so the key is fully supported.
